hooks.command: echo '[PreToolUse] Validating no API keys in file content'

PreCommit.command: grep -r 'sk-ant-\|sk-\|ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=\|OPENAI_API_KEY=\|XAI_API_KEY=' --include='*.js' api/ server.js && echo 'SECRET DETECTED — COMMIT BLOCKED' && exit 1 || echo 'PreCommit: Clean — no secrets detected'

SessionStart.command: echo '=== SaintSal Labs API Session Started ===' && echo 'Repo: SaintSalLabs-API' && echo 'Stack: Node.js | Express | Render | Claude | OpenAI | xAI | Gemini' && git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null || true
